title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_la_esclavitud_del_miedo_by_rodrigo_fica_perez_7fayr (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_la_esclavitud_del_miedo_by_rodrigo_fica_perez_7fayr' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
